mentions.name: Gaming Couch
mentions.description: A web-based local multiplayer party game platform described as a lovechild of Jackbox Games and Mario Party, currently in free Early Access with 18 competitive, action-based mini-games. Up to 8 players per game use mobile phones or game pads as controllers, with quick ~one-minute rounds and no trivia or asynchronous games; everything is completely web-based with no downloads or installs needed to play.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on Gaming Couch, a web-based local multiplayer party game platform. It's like a lovechild of Jackbox Games and Mario Party: https://gamingcouch.com.
